messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Inla crushing
parts:
Hi,
As the error message states, you’re supplying non-integer data to a binomial observation model:
“ *** ERROR *** INLA.Data1: BINOMIAL likelihood is defined on integers, but y[0] = 0.146528767383
“

Perhaps you have transformed your counts to proportions?
If you have the original counts, and the corresponding Ntrials values, you can use a binomial model on the counts. If not, you have to use some other approach, e.g. approximating it with e.g. a Beta distribution model.

Finn
